newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-DataWorks cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-DataWorks cut to neutral.

text.p: Dain Bosworth said Tuesday it cut its rating on DataWorks Corp to neutral from strong buy and reduced earning estimates after the company said second quarter revenues would fall short of estimates.

On Monday, DataWorks said it expected revenues for the quarter ended June 30 would be slightly above the $15.3 million posted for the quarter last year. Dain Bosworth said it had previously estimated $18.6 million.

Dain Bosworth analyst Barry Randall said the revenues indicate earnings per share of $0.12 to $0.13 a share, well below his $0.22 estimate. He said the company does not expect to make up the revenues in upcoming quarters.
Randall cut his earnings estimate for 1997 to $0.88 a share from $0.97 and for 1998 to $1.19 from $1.28.

"Because of the revenue shortfall, and the company's belief that it will not be made up in the subsequent quarters, we are lowering our earnings estimate for the second quarter and for the full year, and lowering our rating to neutral from strong buy," Randall wrote in a report.
